title: Ki
notes: Breaker Crystals are gone. Skills now run on Ki, your fighting spirit: a glowing 0-100 Ki bar fills as you hit, block and defeat enemies.
Every skill shows its Ki cost right on the button (20 / 40 / 60 Ki). If you press a skill too early you see how much Ki is missing.
Keystone Crystal Heart is now Ki Heart (+40 Ki at the start of every fight).
